name: e2e (${{ matrix.mode }}, ${{ matrix.channel }}${{ matrix.store && format(', {0}', matrix.store) || '' }})
# current stable, both image store backends: several digest-identity
# bugs only manifest on one of them (graphdriver vs containerd)
# Single required check for branch protection: it fails if any gating job
# failed, was cancelled or was skipped, except the pull_request-only image
# tests, which are expected to be skipped on push. Adding, renaming or
# splitting a job in the matrices above then needs no change to the
# repository settings. coverage and release are left out on purpose: the
# former depends on an external service, the latter only runs on tags.
name: Check the result of the required jobs
echo "$NEEDS" | jq -e 'to_entries | all(.[]; .value.result == "success" or ((.key | IN("bin-image-test", "relay-image-test")) and .value.result == "skipped"))' > /dev/null
# old stable (latest major - 1). The archive source only resolves exact
